title: SEL and MUX return negative and REAL inputs, the last input, and IN0 for a selector out of range
note: IEC 61131-3 SEL(G, IN0, IN1) returns IN1 when G is TRUE and IN0 otherwise, and MUX(K, IN0, ..., INn) returns INK; ZPLC returns IN0 for a K below 0 or above n (the standard leaves it undefined); the inputs may be negative or REAL
